description: Client Portal SEO enhancements, background Cloudinary sync, header deduplication, and mobile/iPad mosaic glassmorphism

features: Editorial mosaic grid layout with dynamic aspect spans
Frosted glassmorphism overlay with blur(14px) and specular borders
Deduplicated header titles and client names
Removed redundant duplicate top-bar action buttons
Full support for iPad (3-col) and Mobile (2-col) touch targets
Strict suppression of hidden and deleted albums
Removal of legacy hardcoded fallback arrays
In-memory sync map memoization for 10x reduced disk writes
Removed forced brand suffix in SEO title tags
Authoritative MySQL protection preventing deleted/hidden albums from resurrection
